title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot Credits usage report for pay-as-you-go in Copilot Chat
summary: The report paths, privacy controls, consumption API and rollout statements are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. The briefing distinguishes the Credits report from Cost Management reporting and does not present the report's unpublished price as a promise of free access.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Credits report is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Reports > Usage > Reports > Microsoft Copilot > Credits.
claims.quote: In the navigation menu, select Reports. If you don't see Reports, select Show all, and then select Reports. 3. Select Usage. 4. On the Usage page, under Reports, select Microsoft Copilot, and then select Credits.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Copilot Chat Credits report itself as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Credits report API Microsoft Graph reports credits consumption report. Opened Credits report, Cost Management API overview and userUsageRecords, and Power Platform usage-report tutorial; none identifies an API for this report.

claims.claim: Report name concealment is at Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports > Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Select Org Settings. 4. On the Services tab, select Reports. 5. In the Reports panel, uncheck the checkbox next to Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/admin/reportSettings updates tenant report settings using the displayConcealedNames request-body property.
Setting displayConcealedNames to true conceals usernames, groups and sites in reports.
claims.quote: If set to true, all reports conceal user information such as usernames, groups, and sites.

claims.claim: Setting displayConcealedNames to false shows identifiable information.
claims.quote: If false, all reports show identifiable information.

claims.claim: The cited report-settings endpoint is beta and not supported for production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; What's changing; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The Consumption tab is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Consumption.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot > Cost Management. 2. Select the Consumption tab.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/usageReports/userUsageRecords?startDate={startDate}&endDate={endDate} retrieves per-user credit consumption records.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/usageReports/userUsageRecords?startDate=2026-07-01&endDate=2026-07-02&$orderby=consumedQuantity desc&$top=2&$count=true

claims.claim: Each userUsageRecords call must select exactly one completed UTC day.
claims.quote: The range must select exactly one completed UTC day. Current-day, future, and multi-day ranges are rejected, not clamped.

claims.claim: The userUsageRecords permissions table lists delegated work or school permissions.
claims.quote: | Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All | CopilotCostManagement.Read.All |

claims.claim: The userUsageRecords permissions table lists application permissions.
claims.quote: | Application | CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All | CopilotCostManagement.Read.All |

claims.claim: The listed permissions describe the Graph permission model and remain subject to deployment availability and authorization.
claims.quote: This table describes the Graph permission model. See permission availability and authorization for deployment requirements.

claims.claim: The Cost Management userUsageRecords API is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: This per-user daily API is not an equivalent of every Consumption tab breakdown or the Credits report.
claims.quote: Get a list of costManagementUserUsageRecord objects that report each user's consumption of Copilot Credits for one completed UTC day, ranked by consumption.

claims.claim: The Cost Management Consumption tab reports usage by spending policy.
claims.quote: The Consumption tab provides reporting experiences for copilot credit usage by: Spending policy

claims.claim: The Cost Management Consumption tab reports usage by user.
claims.quote: In the Users view, select a user. The details panel shows total credits used, cost, daily credit usage, spending policy history, and credits spent by spending policy for the past month.

claims.claim: The Cost Management Consumption tab reports usage by group.
claims.quote: In the Groups view, review groups included in spending policies. Select a group to open the details panel and view daily usage, assigned policy, cost, and monthly credit limit.

claims.claim: The Cost Management Consumption tab reports usage by agent.
claims.quote:
The Consumption tab provides reporting experiences for copilot credit usage by:
- Spending policy
- User
- Group
- Agent
- Service

claims.claim: The Cost Management Consumption tab reports usage by service.
claims.quote: In the Agents and services view, review usage for supported services. For example, Cowork and Work IQ API.

claims.claim: Cost Management reporting concerns supported services governed through Microsoft 365 usage-based spending policies.
claims.quote: Use Copilot > Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center when you want to manage and monitor Copilot Credit usage for services governed by Microsoft 365 usage-based billing policies.

claims.claim: Learn does not present the Cost Management dashboard as a replacement for the Copilot Chat Credits report.
claims.quote: Searched: Cost Management dashboard Copilot Studio agents future support Credits report replacement. Opened Credits report, Monitor Copilot Credit spending, dashboard comparison, and Manage Copilot Studio costs; none states replacement of the Copilot Chat Credits report.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go usage can take 24 hours to appear in Azure Cost Management.
claims.quote: Billed amounts are updated daily and sometimes more frequently. It can take 24 hours after usage of a service to show in Microsoft Cost Management.

claims.claim: Azure Cost Management is billing-oriented and lacks the same user-level and spending-policy context as the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Shows billing-oriented cost data, such as costs by subscription, service, resource, meter, or invoice period. It doesn't show the same user-level or spending-policy context as the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The Credits report is not a general report of all Copilot Studio agent consumption.
claims.quote: The Credits used metric shows the total credits used from interactions by users in your organization who don't have a Microsoft Copilot license and are interacting with agents in Copilot Chat that spin the Copilot Studio meter during the selected time period.

claims.claim: Eligible Copilot Chat usage appears even when the pay-as-you-go billing policy was configured in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: You can set up the pay-as-you-go billing policy in the Microsoft 365 admin center or Power Platform admin center. If you configure pay-as-you-go, and users without a Microsoft Copilot license use metered agents in Copilot Chat, the data appears in the report.

claims.quote: For example, an agent grounded in a tenant graph could use 12 credits (10 credits for tenant graph-grounding, and two credits for generative answers) to respond to a single complex prompt from a user.

claims.claim: The same example assigns two credits to generative answers for a prompt.

claims.claim: Agent design influences the number of credits consumed.
claims.quote: The number of credits used depends on the design of the agent, how often users interact with it, and the features the agent uses.
